item.name: Haleakala Self-Guided Downhill Bike Tour
item.description:
#Experience Maui’s most breathtaking ride — a self-guided bike tour that takes you from the slopes of Haleakala, through the countryside, all the way down to the sea.

##About
Maui Sunriders has been offering the best Self-Guided Haleakala Downhill Bike experience on Maui for over 24 years. This will be the easiest most picturesque bike ride you'll ever experience as it's almost entirely downhill. There are photo opportunities at almost every turn in the road with sweeping vistas of the slopes of Haleakala and the coast below. 

We meet at Maui Sunriders bike shop in Paia on the north shore by 8:45am. After we outfit you with your gear and provide our safety briefing, you will enjoy a narrated van tour as you’re driven up Haleakala on the same route you’ll bike down! Your guide will point out the local history, points of interest, and suggestions for places to visit. 

The bike ride begins at approximately 6,500 feet right outside the National Park entrance, where all bike operators on Maui begin their rides. You will get to enjoy this self-guided classic route from the mountain to the sea, back to our bike shop in Paia. 

Explore beautiful upcountry Maui on a bike! Smell the eucalyptus and lavender, feel the cool breeze and warm sun, and soak in the beautiful views of Maui.
With our self-paced Haleakala downhill bike ride, you have the freedom to stay in your comfort zone and make stops as you'd like. Enjoy the beauty of Haleakala! 

Experience why visitors & locals love Maui Sunriders and the self-guided bike ride coming down Haleakala. Our guests support local businesses along the route, and the self-paced nature of the ride means we don’t impede and frustrate the local traffic as a large, guided group might. 

This tour includes roadside assistance, so while we aren’t tailing right behind you, rest assured we are a quick phone call away and on the mountain ready to assist you. 

##Estimated Bike Ride Times:

This ride is self-guided, and at your own pace. After our 45-min drive up to the staging area at 6,500', you will begin your bike ride. The average ride start time is 10:30am. Bikes must be returned by 1:30pm.

##Total Duration 

5 Hours 

**Equipment:**
Maui Sunriders provides Front-Suspension Single-Speed Mountain Bikes with disc brakes (the perfect bike for a ride that is 98% downhill), Bell downhill full-face helmets & optional Scott light-weight bike helmets for experienced riders, Trespass (European) rain & wind gear, cold-weather gloves and a backpack which includes a lock and weatherproof road map with road safety rules.

**Suggestions:**

- Dress in light layers, temps at 6500’ are often in the mid to low 60’s, occasionally high 50’s.
- Wear closed-toe shoes
- Bring Sunglasses
- Bring Sunscreen
- Bring $ for meal stop & possible shopping
- Bring Camera
- Tips are greatly appreciated and fully at your discretion, based on the overall experience provided by our team

**Food:**
Meals aren’t provided on this Maui bike tour. Bring cash for food and shopping. We sell water, cold coffee, energy drinks, teas, sodas & energy ride food in our bike shop.

**Guidelines:**
Minimum Age 15 years old
 - Please only sign your child up if you fully understand the ability level & experience required for this bike ride and are confident in their abilities.
 - Minimum Height 4′ 11′
 - Parent or Guardian must accompany riders under 18 years old
 - No expecting mothers
 - No Beginner Bike Riders, Must be a competent bike rider
 - Maximum Weight 300
 - Bikes must be returned by 1:30pm
 - 48 hour cancellation policy

*Safety: You are riding on country roads and sharing the road with cars. There are switchbacks and turns that you need to navigate turns safely and stay on the right side of the lane/shoulder. This ride is 98% downhill with an average grade of 5% decline. This isn't the same as trail riding or riding on a bike path. Due to the downhill momentum, it is important to be an EXPERIENCED and CONFIDENT cyclist and have experience using disc brakes on a bike.
item.booking_notes:
**Things to Bring/Remember:**

- Wear closed-toe shoes
- Bring Sunglasses
- Bring Sunscreen
- Dress in Light Layers
- Bring a Rain Jacket if you have one, otherwise one is included
- Bring $ for meal stop, possible shopping & singles for fruit stands 
- Bring Camera
- Water (we also sell water in the shop)
* Tip: Any day on Maui has a chance of rain, even on a blue-bird beautiful day and especially during winter. If you do get wet, it's nice to have a change of clothes and flip-flops for after the ride.

**Estimated Itinerary**

 - 8:45am: Check-in at our Paia shop. Gear fitting & safety briefing
 - 9am: If you are not here by 9am you risk not being able to participate as we cannot hold the vans for late parties
 - Once Check-In is Complete: Begin 45 min. narrated drive to the ride staging area at  6,500′

**Ride Experience:**

 - Start 6.5-mile self-guided ride through spectacular upcountry Maui ranchland
 - Van pickup: 15-minute drive through congested highway
 - Unload bikes and ride into Makawao town. An unstructured hour to explore!
 - By 12:45pm: Begin self-guided 7-mile descent back to our shop in Paia…right where you started!
 - 1:30pm All riders back to Paia and bikes off Baldwin Ave

---
**Weather and What to Wear:**
The weather can be unpredictable in the tropics so dress comfortably. We will provide you with a wind/rain jacket and pants, bike gloves, as well as a helmet, backpack, bike lock & a map. If the forecast calls for sun, you can get away with shorts and a shirt. If the weather calls for clouds, wind, or showers you may want leggings/pants and light removable upper layers.


---
Because this tour is 98% downhill with virtually no climbing, we’ve simplified our fleet to single-speed, front-suspension mountain bikes. With thousands of guests riding our bikes each year, single-speed bikes help minimize mechanical issues and ensure a smooth, worry-free ride. We understand that some advanced cyclists may prefer gears. If you have any concerns, please feel free to call our Paia shop (ext. 1) so we can chat about the ride and make sure you have a great experience.

---
**Gratuity is appreciated and is an expression of your satisfaction if you feel your guide provided an exceptional experience. Tips go directly to your guide and recognize the wide-ranging care they provide—from guiding the ride, to maintaining and preparing equipment, to ensuring your safety on the tour. Gratuity is entirely at your discretion; however, 18–20% of the ticket price is a common benchmark.


If you have any questions, feel free to contact us. Mahalo for choosing Maui Sunriders and we look forward to seeing you soon!

start_location.name: Paia - Self-Guided Downhill Tour
start_location.note:
**Check-In Time: 8:45-9 AM (*Please aim to arrive by around 8:45am*)**

**We have a strict departure time** If you are running late there is a good chance you may miss the ride. Please be sure you calculate how long it takes to get to our shop and leave with enough time to arrive between 8:45-9am.

- We are located in Pāʻia on Maui’s North Shore. We are not street-front and are located toward the back of the Pāʻia Plaza Building in Suite C2. When facing the building, go to the right side and turn left into the parking lot. We are located toward the back of the plaza. Please do not park in the Mana Foods parking lot to the left, as parking there is limited to 2 hours.
---
**Parking:**

- Parking Directly in front of our shop is a Paid Parking lot. Pay via a QR Code/App found on a post in the parking lot. Scan the app to pay via credit card. Parking is by the hour.

- There is free parking at the Paia Town Public Parking lot on your right side when you first enter the town of Paia or you can park past the post office on the right side shoulder. (5 min. walk to our shop)

- Please don't leave valuables in your car! 
- Please don't park in the Mana foods parking lot or on the street where signs say 1-2 hour parking, as they do ticket in Paia. 

![Parking Map](https://mauisunriders.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/PAIA-PARKING-MAP-MSBC.png)
